title: Review what changed in the release since build b (one local page)
instructions: Open ~/fw-release/build-2026-10-13e/review-delta.html in your browser (Finder: Go > Go to Folder, paste ~/fw-release/build-2026-10-13e, double-click review-delta.html). It shows only what is new or changed since the page you reviewed: 168 new pictures (the 65 with text found come first), 12 new and 2 changed texts, and the README. Tick anything that should not be public, press Copy flagged list and paste it here, or write: nothing flagged.
